description: This file provides extension properties for the AnyCodable type to convert its value into various supported types such as String, Bool, Int, Double, Dictionary, and Array. It facilitates type-safe access to the underlying data encapsulated by AnyCodable, enabling easy data extraction and conversion.

methods.name: stringValue
methods.description: Returns the value as a String if possible.

methods.name: boolValue
methods.description: Returns the value as a Bool if possible, including NSNumber booleans.

methods.name: intValue
methods.description: Returns the value as an Int if possible, with checks for NSNumber and numeric conversions.

methods.name: doubleValue
methods.description: Returns the value as a Double if possible, including conversions from Int and NSNumber.

methods.name: dictionaryValue
methods.description: Returns the value as a Dictionary with String keys and AnyCodable values if possible, handling various underlying types.

methods.name: arrayValue
methods.description: Returns the value as an Array of AnyCodable if possible, handling various underlying types.

methods.name: foundationValue
methods.description: Converts the AnyCodable value into a Foundation-compatible type, recursively handling dictionaries and arrays.
